DegreeYourWay emails

8 templates, sample values filled in. Built from emails/templates.mjs.

Your free call with Shreyashcall-requested: Lead saved with source discovery_call or popup_pathfinder
Your free call is bookedcall-booked: Booking tool webhook (Cal.com or Calendly) when a call is booked. Turn off the tool’s own confirmation if you send this.
Your free Parent’s Guide to degree apprenticeshipsparents-guide: Lead saved with source parents_guide
Your Pathfinder resultspathfinder-report: Lead saved with source quiz_roadmap
Which of your matches opens first?pathfinder-follow-up: Two days after quiz_roadmap, only if no call has been booked and TOP_MATCH is known
Your place request: what happens nextplace-requested: Lead saved with source booking (the reserve form)
Your place is helddeposit-received: Sent by hand or by the payment provider’s webhook once the £100 deposit is paid
Your DegreeYourWay talk requestschool-talk: Lead saved with source school_talk. HANDOUT_URL is the site address plus the handout link /api/lead returns.
